status_as_of_cutoff: As of 2026-08-11, local-process evidence remains the highest confirmed status. City of Hillsboro materials confirm DR-012-26 Coresite Data Center was posted as a development-review public notice before the July 27, 2026 temporary land-use moratorium. The moratorium pauses acceptance of new or expanded primary-use data-center/BESS applications for 120 days but states projects with applications submitted before the moratorium may continue to develop. Phase 1 is described in the earlier notice record as a three-story 234,531-square-foot building and Phase 2 as a four-story 312,708-square-foot shell; local reporting describes the combined proposed campus as 547,239 square feet at 5420 NE Sewell Avenue. Final land-use approval, building permit issuance, construction start, inspection, CO, utility/interconnection, energization, service date, and project MW capacity were not located.
evidence_grade: B: official City sources confirm the application notice, citywide moratorium, and continued processing of pre-moratorium applications; address/combined square footage/owner details rely on local reporting and SEC/entity evidence rather than a directly accessible city application packet.

actions.government_body: City of Hillsboro Community Development Department
actions.action_type: consolidated development review / significant natural resource permit public notice
actions.result_status: The city posted notice of administrative review for DR-012-26, describing phased development of a CoreSite data-center campus on approximately 19.73 acres. Phase 1 is a three-story 234,531-square-foot building and Phase 2 a four-story 312,708-square-foot shell; the notice also describes a Significant Natural Resource Permit and site improvements.
actions.access_caveat: The notice is an administrative-review notice and does not say final approval was issued; the attached site plan/elevations were not treated as a permit or construction evidence.
actions.evidence_note: Official application/notice; no final approval or build status inferred.

actions.government_body: City of Hillsboro City Manager's Office
actions.result_status: The July 7, 2026 City Manager's Report listed DR-012-26 Coresite Data Center among recently posted public notices for development review of data center sites.
actions.access_caveat: Report confirms posted development-review notice only; it does not provide approval, permit issuance, or construction evidence.
actions.evidence_note: Official city recap corroborating DR-012-26 was in development-review notice stage.

actions.result_status: City Council enacted a 120-day moratorium on accepting land-use applications for new or expanded primary-use data centers and BESS facilities; the city stated projects that submitted applications before the moratorium may continue to develop.
actions.vote_tally: approved; city news release does not publish a roll-call tally
actions.access_caveat: Moratorium is citywide and is not a project-specific approval or denial for DR-012-26.
actions.evidence_note: Official city action affects intake of new/expanded applications but does not itself change DR-012-26 to approved/permitted or construction.

actions.result_status: The city published a two-phase schedule for data-center/BESS code amendments, utility-service pre-submittal requirements, environmental/economic analysis, and public meetings, with the 120-day moratorium ending November 24, 2026 unless extended.
actions.access_caveat: Citywide regulatory process; no project-specific DR-012-26 approval, denial, permit, or construction milestone found.
actions.evidence_note: Official schedule for policy review during moratorium.
